statements.proposition: The change is backwards compatible with v1.7.0
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: Concrete check: the tsconfig exclusion stops the build from emitting dist/agentdb/cli/agentdb-cli.js (and dist/agentdb/controllers etc.), which the package's `agentdb` bin and deep imports used to resolve to; so the released package is not fully backwards compatible with v1.7.0/base. Not verified by running the build.
evidence: PR head tsconfig (agentic-flow/config/tsconfig.json) adds excludes ../src/agentdb/cli/**, controllers/**, optimizations/**, benchmarks/**, tests/**; base and tag v1.7.0 tsconfig have none (gh api contents at base 089c16c and tag v1.7.0)
package.json bin `agentdb` -> dist/agentdb/cli/agentdb-cli.js is present at base, v1.7.0 and head and was not changed by the PR

build script is `tsc -p config/tsconfig.json`; grep of src at head shows nothing outside src/agentdb imports the embedded src/agentdb/cli or controllers (new code imports the npm package 'agentdb/controllers/...'), so excluded files are not emitted
I did not run the build; conclusion rests on reading config and imports
Otherwise the change is mostly additive (new files HybridBackend.ts, AdvancedMemory.ts, index-new.ts, tests, docs) and no exports-map entry was removed
